description: Vessel speed for video transects must be kept to 1 knot or lower, and never exceed 3 knots.
context_quote: Vessel speed was usually kept to 1 knot or lower and never exceeded 3 knots.

description: The camera sled must be positioned 0.5-1.5 meters above the seafloor during video transects.
context_quote: The camera sled was lowered until positioned 0.5-1.5 meters above the seafloor.

description: Grab samples must be more than 50% full, not over-penetrated, and have undisturbed surface structures to be considered acceptable.
context_quote: A sample was initially deemed acceptable only if the bucket was more than 50% full, the sample was not over penetrated (i.e., not full to the top), and sample surface structures were undisturbed and even (i.e., not slumped).

description: No more than three failed grab sample attempts are allowed at a single station before moving on to the next station.
context_quote: If more than three failed sample attempts occurred at one station, sampling moved on to the next station (no more than three fails occurred in any one sampling station).
